```{r libs, include = FALSE}
library(mosaic)
library(tidyr)
library(exams)
```


```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
# Random Data
mw <- sample(2*1:5,1)
sa <- sample(c(1/2,3/2),1) * mw
mw <- sample(c(-1,1),1) * mw
x <- seq(mw-3*sa, mw+3*sa, length = 1000)
Dichte <- dnorm(x, mean = mw, sd = sa)

questions <- character(7)
questions[1] <- paste("$\\mu=$", mw, ", $\\sigma=$", sa)
questions[2] <- paste("$\\mu=$", -mw, ", $\\sigma=$", sa)
questions[3] <- paste("$\\mu=$", sa, ", $\\sigma=$", mw)
questions[4] <- paste("$\\mu=$", 0, ", $\\sigma=$", 1)
questions[5] <- paste("$\\mu=$", sa, ", $\\sigma=$", sa)
questions[6] <- paste("$\\mu=$", mw, ", $\\sigma=$", -sa)
questions[7] <- paste("$\\mu=$", mw, ", $\\sigma=$", mw)


solutions <- rep(FALSE, 7)
solutions[1] <- TRUE
```


Question
========

```{r show-plot, echo = FALSE, results="hide", fig.height = 4, fig.width = 6, fig.cap = ""}
gf_line(Dichte ~ x) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = NULL)
```


Welche Parameterwerte hat die Normalverteilung?


```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(questions, markup = "markdown")
```



Solution
========


Aufgabenname: `verteilungen2a`



```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(ifelse(solutions, "Wahr", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
